system.description:
An emergency implant under the skin that protects against vacuum damage and carries about a minute of air, popular with anyone who spends long periods in space.

Poor: air for only three rounds. Good: also gives 2 AP to all locations, not stacking with worn armor. Best: as Good, detectable only by a medical scan, with air for five minutes.
system.effectText: Vacuum protection, about one minute of air. Poor: three rounds. Good: 2 AP all locations (no stacking). Best: undetectable, five minutes.
